name: Tully's Coffee Toyosu Front
nameJa: タリーズコーヒー 豊洲フロント店
description: A station-front Tully's a minute from Toyosu with free Wi-Fi and outlets along the counter and window seats, opening early for morning work.

name: R.O.STAR Toyosu Front
nameJa: アール・オー・スター 豊洲フロント店
description: A budget self-serve coffee stand steps from the station exit with outlet-equipped window counter seating, though its Wi-Fi requires a receipt password.

name: San Marc Cafe Lalaport Toyosu
nameJa: サンマルクカフェ ららぽーと豊洲店
description: A mall-based San Marc in Lalaport Toyosu offering free Wi-Fi and power outlets at its window seating for casual laptop sessions.

name: Pronto Toyosu
address: 3-3-3 Toyosu, Center Bldg B1F, Koto-ku, Tokyo
description: A basement Pronto near the station with free Wi-Fi and outlets at tables and along the wall, running as a cafe by day and bar later.

name: Starbucks Toyosu Foresia
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー 豊洲フォレシア店
description: A Starbucks in the Foresia office building offering free Wi-Fi and outlets along the window counter for focused work.

name: Starbucks Lalaport Toyosu 3
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー ららぽーと豊洲3店
description: A Lalaport Starbucks with free Wi-Fi and outlets at both center tables and the counter, open late for evening work.

name: Komeda Coffee Lalaport Toyosu
nameJa: コメダ珈琲店 ららぽーと豊洲店
description: A spacious Komeda in Lalaport with free Wi-Fi and power outlets at nearly all seats, ideal for long stays.

name: SoloTime Toyosu
nameJa: ソロタイム 豊洲店
description: A work-oriented cafe designed for solo laptop users, with free Wi-Fi and power at every seat and very late weekday hours.

name: SPBS Toyosu
description: A bookstore cafe in Lalaport with high-speed free Wi-Fi and outlets at all seats, suited to reading and laptop work.

name: Story Table Lalaport Toyosu
nameJa: ストーリーテーブル 有隣堂ららぽーと豊洲店
description: A bookstore-adjacent cafe with free Wi-Fi and outlets along a wall/window counter, directly connected to the Lalaport concourse.

name: Starbucks Atre Kameido
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー アトレ亀戸店
description: A Starbucks inside the Atre building at Kameido station with free Wi-Fi and outlets at part of the counter seating.

name: Komeda Coffee Atre Kameido
nameJa: コメダ珈琲店 アトレ亀戸店
description: A Komeda in Atre Kameido offering free Wi-Fi and outlets at some counter seats for relaxed longer visits.

name: McDonald's Kameido
nameJa: マクドナルド 亀戸店
address: 5-2-1 Kameido, Kameido EX Bldg 1-3F, Koto-ku, Tokyo
description: A multi-floor McDonald's by Kameido station providing free Wi-Fi and power outlets, a budget option for quick work.

name: Starbucks Kiba Ito-Yokado
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー 木場イトーヨーカドー店
description: A large Starbucks in the Fukagawa Gathering complex near Kiba with free Wi-Fi and roughly twenty outlet-equipped seats.

name: Books & Cafe Dreadnought
nameJa: ブックス&カフェ ドレッドノート
description: A book cafe near Kiba with free Wi-Fi and outlets, including a set of desk seats built for laptop work.

name: Kohikan Monzen-nakacho
nameJa: 珈琲館 門前仲町店
description: A traditional Kohikan coffee house in Monzen-nakacho reported to offer Wi-Fi and outlets for a calm work environment.

name: Kohikan Ojima
description: A Kohikan coffee house in Ojima with free Wi-Fi and power outlets, open from early morning until night.

name: Tully's Coffee Ariake Garden
nameJa: タリーズコーヒー 有明ガーデン店
description: A Tully's on the Ariake Garden family floor with free Wi-Fi and around twenty seats offering AC and USB power.
